query:
SELECT 
  c.name AS contact_name,
  ccf.fieldName,
  ccf.fieldValue AS company_name,
  ccf.createdAt
FROM contacts c
LEFT JOIN contact_custom_fields ccf ON c.id = ccf.contactId AND ccf.fieldName = '公司名称'
WHERE c.name IN ('王茜', '李晓洁', '羊仲平', '张珏', '刘强', '马婉义', '钟贝', '杨雪', '秦主任', '丁楠', '郑奎', '洪小燕', '望悦', '卓迪敦', '周翔', '陈奇戎', '王海艳')
ORDER BY c.name;
